content.short: Limitless is a prediction market on Base covering crypto, sports, esports, finance, and politics with short duration markets.
content.description: Limitless is a prediction market built on Base that favours fast turnover over long dated questions, listing hourly and daily markets on crypto prices alongside sports, esports, finance, and politics. Markets show live odds and settle onchain, and the interface is built around quick repeated participation with leaderboards, referral rewards, and team competitions layered on top. That short duration focus makes it read closer to an onchain trading venue than to the slower forecasting boards that dominate the category.
